topic: how to check mobile deposit limit chase
slug: how to check mobile deposit limit chase

persona.name: Jordan Avery

steps.instruction: Open your chase app and sign in.
On the home screen, tap "Deposit checks" in the quick actions row.
If the Chase QuickDeposit agreement appears, tick the box to agree, then tap "Deposit a check".
On the QuickDeposit screen, tap "Deposit to" and select your TOTAL CHECKING account.
Right below the deposit amount field, "Your current mobile deposit limit is $7,500.00" shows your limit.
Tap "Learn more" for details on deposit limits and when your money is available.
